hook: Hop like a frog, gallop like a horse, balance like a flamingo. Each animal brings a skill, simple form cues and its own beat, then the music stops and everyone freezes.
outcome: Practice locomotor and balance skills with simple form cues, at different speeds, sizes and levels
sources: Illustrations drawn with FLUX.2 [klein] 4B (Apache 2.0) on Cloudflare Workers AI, edited for Curio Class
Music and sounds generated in the browser
